purpose: A single container for the active Blender production skill stack.

skills.name: blender-production-router
skills.role: Sole authority for task routing, production stages, retry budgets, rollback targets, official documentation retrieval, native-generator comparison, and artifact contracts.

skills.name: blender-local-asset-library
skills.role: Read-only discovery and background inspection of explicitly requested local Blender node assets; never owns route, stage, import, or validation decisions.

skills.name: blender-scene-design
skills.role: Visual thesis, focal hierarchy, depth layers, visual flow, scale and repetition rhythm, camera mobility, representation fidelity, performance budgets, and local design repair intent without Blender mutation or route authority.

skills.name: blender-reference-reconstruction
skills.role: Reference-image evidence, spatial-region and portal hypotheses, provisional camera solving, scale and hidden-space reasoning, material identity, uncertainty control, and measurable convergence gates.

skills.name: blender-direct-surface-modeling
skills.role: Direct mesh, BMesh, subdivision, Boolean architectural openings, Displace relief, remesh, sculpt, retopology, and connection construction.

skills.name: blender-assembly-structure
skills.role: Manufacturing-based Part Graphs, object boundaries, seams, mating interfaces, pivots, modular grids, precision snapping, constraints, hierarchy, and assembly validation.

skills.name: blender-deformation-rigging
skills.role: Native deformation modifiers, armatures, shape keys, constraints, and drivers.

skills.name: blender-simulation-effects
skills.role: Cloth, soft body, rigid body, fluids, dynamic paint, ocean, waves, particles, boids, forces, and fracture routing.

skills.name: blender-procedural-systems
skills.role: Array-driven stairs and modules, curve-profile generation, instancing, Geometry Nodes, repeat/simulation zones, scattering, and crowd systems.

skills.name: blender-geometry-nodes-studio
skills.role: Dedicated Geometry Nodes graph construction, layout, source-asset gating, evaluated topology, instancing, and simulation-zone validation.

skills.name: blender-material-surfacing
skills.role: PBR mapping, metal, wood, water, wetness, layered aging, displacement, and material-response validation.

skills.name: blender-lighting-analysis
skills.role: Reference-light inference, accountable Sun and World gray-light passes, source justification, and production-light validation.

skills.name: blender-npr-eevee
skills.role: Eevee Shader-to-RGB toon bands and deformation-following inverted-hull Geometry Nodes outlines.

skills.name: blender-npr-cycles
skills.role: Blender 5.2+ Cycles four-direction Shader Raycast silhouettes and Cycles-compatible toon shading.

skills.name: blender-geometry-validation
skills.role: Geometry, surface, connection, collision, simulation, performance, and protected-scene validation.
